title: Fit a car battery into a 3.3 V ADC
story: Your 3.3 V microcontroller must measure a car battery that can reach 14.4 V while charging. A 33 kohm resistor is already fitted from the battery to the ADC pin. Choose the bottom resistor so that at 14.4 V the pin sits between 2.7 V and 3.3 V: inside the ADC's range, but using most of it.

goals.label: ADC pin between 2.7 V and 3.3 V at 14.4 V
divider draws under 0.5 mA from the battery

hints: You want a ratio between 2.7 / 14.4 = 0.1875 and 3.3 / 14.4 = 0.229.
10 k looks tidy, but 14.4 x 10 / 43 is a little too much.
